title: Initial import: full FastAPI+React app baseline (no prior security fixes)
description: Root commit introducing the whole codebase. No vulnerabilities fixed (nothing existed before). Security posture introduced: backend (backend/app) exposes unauthenticated FastAPI endpoints /api/plans, /api/leads/create, /api/contact, /api/calculator; SQLAlchemy+SQLite default DB (backend/app/core/config.py); CORS allow_credentials=True with 3 hardcoded origins (localhost:3000, localhost:5173, dfcont.com.br) and allow_methods/headers=*; lead.py route re-exposes raw exception text via detail=str(e); DEBUG defaults True (docs_url enabled); frontend/src/services/api.js hardcodes API base URL. No auth, no rate limiting, no input sanitization layers exist anywhere.

title: Fix attempt broke backend: self-import of PlanDB inside plan.py causes ImportError
description: Committed as "Update plan and plans modules with necessary imports and adjustments". Added `from app.api.models.plan import PlanDB` inside plan.py itself (backend/app/api/models/plan.py:6), before the PlanDB class is defined. Verified: importing app.api.routes.plans raises `ImportError: cannot import name 'PlanDB' from partially initialized module`, so the entire FastAPI app fails to start (availability regression). Not a security fix; the only fix in history and it is broken. Downstream: do not assume `import app.api.routes.plans` works; the app currently cannot boot.
mitigation_diff: Remove self-import line in plan.py (import was already available via the module itself).
